trt_walker.text: The Trotternish ridge is one long walk with a view on the one side and a view on the other. In between is a path that is not always there.
Everyone takes a photograph of the Old Man. The Old Man does not mind. He has been photographed more than the Queen.

trt_museum.text: The blackhouse here has a peat fire and a bed in the corner for the cow. I would not want to live in one. I would not want it demolished either.
Fàilte. That is 'welcome'. The kettle is always on, because the peat is always lit.

trt_cross.text: Flora MacDonald is buried here. A woman who did something very brave and then was very modest about it. I find that restful.
She is said to have said she would have done the same for any man in distress. I notice she did not say it twice.

trt_fossil.text: Those are not scratch marks. Those are footprints. A dinosaur walked across this mud about a hundred and seventy million years ago and nobody told it to stop.
The tide comes in fast. If you are looking for the best prints, bring a torch and a good excuse.

trt_eagle.text: A golden eagle hangs on the wind above the Quiraing, taking in the whole of Skye as though it had a mortgage on it.
